name: Waypass
summary: A passport sign-up: the cover swings open, your details print on the data page and entry stamps thump down
about: A full sign-in and sign-up page shaped like an open passport over a sky of drifting clouds, flight routes and a split-flap departure board. The cover swings open on load, your name, city and email print onto the data page and its machine-readable lines as you type, and a UV security check blurs your details and shutters the photo while you enter a password. A wrong password slams a red DENIED stamp, every password rule on sign-up earns a country stamp, and signing in stamps ADMITTED while a plane takes off.
how: Watch the passport open and type a demo login by itself, then click any field to take over
Type an email or your name and watch the data page and the bottom code lines fill in
Click the password: the UV check hides your details; the eye button dims it for a peek
Try a wrong password for DENIED, or use Fill it in (zara@waypass.pk, gate7lahore) to be admitted
On Get a pass each password rule stamps a new country, and Lost pass uses the demo code 418207
